summary: Knee arthroscopy in advanced osteoarthritis without mechanical symptoms

request.clinical_notes: 67-year-old retired teacher with chronic left knee pain and swelling for 2 years, worse on stairs. She denies locking, catching or giving way. McMurray test negative. She completed 8 weeks of physical therapy and had a corticosteroid injection 3 months ago with temporary relief. Weight-bearing radiographs show severe medial joint space narrowing, bone-on-bone, Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4. MRI shows a degenerative complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Requesting arthroscopic debridement and partial meniscectomy.
